name: simset-therm-002
description: You want to run production simulations of a condensed-phase material and later compute fluctuation-derived properties (e.g., heat capacity, compressibility). Which thermostat ensures proper sampling of the canonical ensemble (NVT) with correct fluctuations?

examples.input:
units real
atom_style atomic
read_data data.material
pair_style lj/cut 10.0
pair_coeff * * 0.238 3.405

velocity all create 300.0 54321 mom yes

# Which thermostat/fix is most appropriate for canonical (NVT) ensemble sampling with correct fluctuations?
# options (single token): berendsen, nvt, langevin, nve
